datasets.name: customers
queryLines:
-- One row per customer. 'Unknown' is the placeholder dimension row that keeps
-- facts with an unresolved customer joinable (docs/REFERENTIAL_COMPLETENESS.md);
-- it is not a real region or segment, so it is kept out of the business view.
SELECT customer_id, customer_name, region, segment, total_sales, total_profit, total_orders
FROM customer_kpi
WHERE region <> 'Unknown'
  AND segment <> 'Unknown'

datasets.name: top_customers
queryLines:
SELECT
  region_sales_rank AS rank,
  customer_name,
  region,
  segment,
  total_sales,
  total_profit,
  total_orders
FROM customer_kpi
WHERE region <> 'Unknown'
  AND segment <> 'Unknown'
  AND region_sales_rank <= 10
ORDER BY region, region_sales_rank

datasets.name: run_comparison
queryLines:
-- One row per pipeline run is recorded in kpi_run_snapshot (superstore_kpi_snapshot.py).
-- This shows the latest two side by side, so a jump can be read as new data
-- (data covers more days) or restated history (same days, different totals).
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC) AS rn FROM kpi_run_snapshot
),
c AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1),
p AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 2),
j AS (
  SELECT
    c.data_from AS c_data_from,
    c.data_through AS c_data_through,
    c.snapshot_at AS c_snapshot_at,
    c.run_started_at AS c_run_started_at,
    c.trigger_type AS c_trigger_type,
    c.raw_rows_ingested AS c_raw_rows_ingested,
    c.revenue_30d AS c_revenue_30d,
    c.profit_30d AS c_profit_30d,
    c.revenue_total AS c_revenue_total,
    c.profit_total AS c_profit_total,
    c.orders_total AS c_orders_total,
    c.customers_total AS c_customers_total,
    p.data_from AS p_data_from,
    p.data_through AS p_data_through,
    p.snapshot_at AS p_snapshot_at,
    p.run_started_at AS p_run_started_at,
    p.trigger_type AS p_trigger_type,
    p.raw_rows_ingested AS p_raw_rows_ingested,
    p.revenue_30d AS p_revenue_30d,
    p.profit_30d AS p_profit_30d,
    p.revenue_total AS p_revenue_total,
    p.profit_total AS p_profit_total,
    p.orders_total AS p_orders_total,
    p.customers_total AS p_customers_total
  FROM c LEFT JOIN p ON TRUE
)
SELECT 1 AS ord, 'This run' AS run,
  IF(c_data_from IS NULL, '—', CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(c_data_from, 'd MMM yyyy'), ' – ', DATE_FORMAT(c_data_through, 'd MMM yyyy'))) AS data_covers,
  IF(c_snapshot_at IS NULL, '—', CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(from_utc_timestamp(c_snapshot_at, 'Australia/Sydney'), 'EEE d MMM, HH:mm'), ' ', IF(unix_timestamp(from_utc_timestamp(c_snapshot_at, 'Australia/Sydney')) - unix_timestamp(c_snapshot_at) = 39600, 'AEDT', 'AEST'))) AS refreshed,
  CASE c_trigger_type WHEN 'periodic' THEN 'scheduled' WHEN 'one_time' THEN 'manual' WHEN 'run_job_task' THEN 'integration test' WHEN NULL THEN '—' ELSE c_trigger_type END AS trigger,
  CASE WHEN (c_revenue_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((c_revenue_total)) >= 1e9 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total)) / 1e9, 2), 'bn') WHEN ABS((c_revenue_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total)) / 1e6, 2), 'm') WHEN ABS((c_revenue_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total)), 0)) END AS revenue,
  CASE WHEN (c_profit_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((c_profit_total)) >= 1e9 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total)) / 1e9, 2), 'bn') WHEN ABS((c_profit_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total)) / 1e6, 2), 'm') WHEN ABS((c_profit_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total)), 0)) END AS profit,
  CASE WHEN (c_orders_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((c_orders_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_orders_total)) / 1e6, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS((c_orders_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_orders_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_orders_total)), 0)) END AS orders,
  CASE WHEN (c_customers_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((c_customers_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_customers_total)) / 1e6, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS((c_customers_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_customers_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_customers_total)), 0)) END AS customers
FROM j
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS ord, 'Last run' AS run,
  IF(p_data_from IS NULL, '—', CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p_data_from, 'd MMM yyyy'), ' – ', DATE_FORMAT(p_data_through, 'd MMM yyyy'))) AS data_covers,
  IF(p_snapshot_at IS NULL, '—', CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(from_utc_timestamp(p_snapshot_at, 'Australia/Sydney'), 'EEE d MMM, HH:mm'), ' ', IF(unix_timestamp(from_utc_timestamp(p_snapshot_at, 'Australia/Sydney')) - unix_timestamp(p_snapshot_at) = 39600, 'AEDT', 'AEST'))) AS refreshed,
  CASE p_trigger_type WHEN 'periodic' THEN 'scheduled' WHEN 'one_time' THEN 'manual' WHEN 'run_job_task' THEN 'integration test' WHEN NULL THEN '—' ELSE p_trigger_type END AS trigger,
  CASE WHEN (p_revenue_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((p_revenue_total)) >= 1e9 THEN CONCAT(IF((p_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_revenue_total)) / 1e9, 2), 'bn') WHEN ABS((p_revenue_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((p_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_revenue_total)) / 1e6, 2), 'm') WHEN ABS((p_revenue_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((p_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_revenue_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((p_revenue_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_revenue_total)), 0)) END AS revenue,
  CASE WHEN (p_profit_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((p_profit_total)) >= 1e9 THEN CONCAT(IF((p_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_profit_total)) / 1e9, 2), 'bn') WHEN ABS((p_profit_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((p_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_profit_total)) / 1e6, 2), 'm') WHEN ABS((p_profit_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((p_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_profit_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((p_profit_total) < 0, '−$', '$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_profit_total)), 0)) END AS profit,
  CASE WHEN (p_orders_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((p_orders_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_orders_total)) / 1e6, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS((p_orders_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_orders_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_orders_total)), 0)) END AS orders,
  CASE WHEN (p_customers_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN ABS((p_customers_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_customers_total)) / 1e6, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS((p_customers_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_customers_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT('', FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((p_customers_total)), 0)) END AS customers
FROM j
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS ord, 'Change' AS run,
  CASE WHEN p_data_through IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN c_data_through = p_data_through AND c_data_from = p_data_from THEN 'same period' ELSE CONCAT(IF(datediff(c_data_through, p_data_through) >= 0, '+', '−'), ABS(datediff(c_data_through, p_data_through)), ' days of data') END AS data_covers,
  IF(p_snapshot_at IS NULL, '—', CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER((unix_timestamp(c_snapshot_at) - unix_timestamp(p_snapshot_at)) / 3600, 1), ' h later')) AS refreshed,
  '' AS trigger,
  CASE WHEN (c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN (c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total) = 0 THEN 'no change' WHEN ABS((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total)) >= 1e9 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total)) / 1e9, 2), 'bn') WHEN ABS((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total)) / 1e6, 2), 'm') WHEN ABS((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_revenue_total - p_revenue_total)), 0)) END AS revenue,
  CASE WHEN (c_profit_total - p_profit_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN (c_profit_total - p_profit_total) = 0 THEN 'no change' WHEN ABS((c_profit_total - p_profit_total)) >= 1e9 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total - p_profit_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total - p_profit_total)) / 1e9, 2), 'bn') WHEN ABS((c_profit_total - p_profit_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total - p_profit_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total - p_profit_total)) / 1e6, 2), 'm') WHEN ABS((c_profit_total - p_profit_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total - p_profit_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total - p_profit_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((c_profit_total - p_profit_total) < 0, '▼ −$', '▲ +$'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_profit_total - p_profit_total)), 0)) END AS profit,
  CASE WHEN (c_orders_total - p_orders_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN (c_orders_total - p_orders_total) = 0 THEN 'no change' WHEN ABS((c_orders_total - p_orders_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_orders_total - p_orders_total) < 0, '▼ −', '▲ +'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_orders_total - p_orders_total)) / 1e6, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS((c_orders_total - p_orders_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_orders_total - p_orders_total) < 0, '▼ −', '▲ +'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_orders_total - p_orders_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((c_orders_total - p_orders_total) < 0, '▼ −', '▲ +'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_orders_total - p_orders_total)), 0)) END AS orders,
  CASE WHEN (c_customers_total - p_customers_total) IS NULL THEN '—' WHEN (c_customers_total - p_customers_total) = 0 THEN 'no change' WHEN ABS((c_customers_total - p_customers_total)) >= 1e6 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_customers_total - p_customers_total) < 0, '▼ −', '▲ +'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_customers_total - p_customers_total)) / 1e6, 1), 'M') WHEN ABS((c_customers_total - p_customers_total)) >= 1e3 THEN CONCAT(IF((c_customers_total - p_customers_total) < 0, '▼ −', '▲ +'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_customers_total - p_customers_total)) / 1e3, 1), 'k') ELSE CONCAT(IF((c_customers_total - p_customers_total) < 0, '▼ −', '▲ +'), FORMAT_NUMBER(ABS((c_customers_total - p_customers_total)), 0)) END AS customers
FROM j
ORDER BY ord

datasets.name: page_status
queryLines:
-- Query time is when this page ran its queries: it changes on every refresh of
-- the page, unlike the data refresh time. Freshness uses the same 9-day (216 h)
-- threshold as the freshness alert; prod refreshes weekly, Sundays 06:00.
SELECT
  IF(current_timestamp() IS NULL, '—', CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'Australia/Sydney'), 'EEE d MMM, HH:mm'), ' ', IF(unix_timestamp(from_utc_timestamp(current_timestamp(), 'Australia/Sydney')) - unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) = 39600, 'AEDT', 'AEST'))) AS queried,
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(snapshot_at) IS NULL THEN 'No run recorded'
    WHEN (unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(MAX(snapshot_at))) / 3600 <= 216 THEN 'Fresh'
    ELSE 'Stale (9+ days)'
  END AS status
FROM kpi_run_snapshot

lines: All-time customer value by region and segment.

*Synthetic data. The business patterns (discount-driven margin, seasonality, regional differences) are modelled in the data generator. The feed also carries one older file from a previous generator (about 1M rows, Jan 2025 to Mar 2026, −10% margin), which is why margin dips in early 2026. Details: docs/DASHBOARDS.md.*
